subject.title: fix(talk): reject malformed relay audio base64

question: Should Gateway-owned Talk relays now reject every malformed or noncanonical base64 frame that Node previously decoded permissively?
rationale: The implementation is correct and preserves documented valid inputs, but only the Talk owner can authorize the deliberate shipped compatibility change for custom relay clients.

options.title: Accept strict relay validation
options.body: Merge the shared fail-closed decoder because the public contract requires base64 PCM and the proof preserves standard and URL-safe clients.

options.title: Require a compatibility exception
options.body: Request a narrowly documented exception only if maintainers know of a shipped client that emits a specific noncanonical form.

options.title: Pause for client audit
options.body: Hold the PR until first-party and known external Talk clients are checked for noncanonical frame generation.

recommendation.title: Accept strict relay validation
recommendation.body: Merge the shared fail-closed decoder because the public contract requires base64 PCM and the proof preserves standard and URL-safe clients.

likelyOwner.reason: VACInc is credited with introducing the Gateway relay contract being tightened.
